_comment: Maintained by Claude — see ../CLAUDE.md 'Dashboard Maintenance' rule. Status values: concept | in-progress | review | ready | archived. Keys in 'mocks' are folder paths relative to products/SafeLMS/ (no trailing /index.html).

recentChanges.summary: Swapped the flow switcher versions so V1 is now the Completions-by-Employee flow and V2 is the Compliance-by-Employee flow.
Reworded the V1 modal intro to describe duplicating the selected variant into a customizable Learning Studio course, and changed the warning banner colors from red to orange.

Added a bottom flow version switcher: V1 applies the Compliance-by-Employee flow (position block, email-address toggle, default loading text + email toast) to every tab; V2 applies the Completions-by-Employee flow (inline 'email me the report' button, no toast) to every tab.

Reworded the V1 warning banner copy to 'Modifying this course may affect its ability to meet regulatory, certification, or compliance requirements. Please ensure compliance is maintained after any changes.'
Refined V1 modal: removed the blue info banner, gave the warning banner a light-red square triangle-warning icon and a dismiss button, bolded its copy, and shortened the compliance text.
Added a bottom version switcher (V1/V2): V1 is the new 'Create and Launch Learning Studio' modal with intro copy plus info and compliance-warning banners; V2 is the prior launcher modal.

recentChanges.path: async-reports/index.html, reports/index.html, test/index.html, timeout modal SAFELMS-30656/index.html
recentChanges.summary: Annotated every element with data-file/data-line and added the feedback comment widget so pinned comments open the exact source line in VS Code across the remaining SafeLMS mocks (dashboard excluded).
Annotated every element with data-file/data-line and added the feedback comment widget so pinned comments can open the exact source line in VS Code.

Centered the confirm-page copy vertically and pinned the Confirm button to the bottom; widened the confirm page to 560px (success modal stays 380px, both 375px tall) and removed the border on the green check badge.
Expanded the compliance warning copy, centered the body text, and moved the divider line between the header and body.
Dropped Cancel, renamed primary action to Confirm, and wired the button to swap the modal to a success state (green check, 'Learning Studio is open in a new tab.').
Widened the Learning Studio launcher modal, replaced the success checkmark with Cancel / Acknowledge and Continue actions.
Added Learning Studio launcher compliance warning modal on the Courses (Learning Studio tab) view.

Pinned the filter grid to col 2 so pills stay spread out when pos-block is hidden, synced pos-block / email-toggle visibility to the active tab, and reworked the in-loading 'email me' button to stay in place and adopt a pressed checkmark state after click instead of disappearing.
Stood up the auto-syncing prototype index dashboard.

async-reports.description: Reports experience with asynchronous, background-generated exports and download history. Includes a V1/V2 flow switcher (V1 = Completions-by-Employee flow, V2 = Compliance-by-Employee flow, applied to every tab).

LS integration warning.title: LS Integration Warning
LS integration warning.description: Learning Studio launch modal warning users they are creating an editable copy of a Vector course and are responsible for compliance. Includes a V1/V2 design switcher.

reports.description: SafeLMS reports landing page with training and course completion data tables.

test.description: Experimental scratch space for in-flight SafeLMS prototype work.

timeout modal SAFELMS-30656.description: Warning modal that prompts users when their session is about to expire.
